==== hoistOrder.tlua (0 errors) ====
    // Hoisted function declarations bind before the statements around them, so the
    // recorded calls must be sorted back into source order: the top-level pairing
    // here runs first and is never protected, and the body's pairing is the latest.
    Hoisted = Hoisted or {};
    setmetatable(Hoisted, { __index = { early = 1 } });
    function protectLater(): void
      setmetatable(Hoisted, {
        __index = { late = 2 },
        __metatable = "locked",
      });
    end

==== cycleUse.tlua (1 errors) ====
    // Mutually referential metatable arguments cannot both capture the other
    // paired -- the cycle must break somewhere -- but where it breaks is canonical:
    // paired symbols resolve in program order, so CycA's literal captures CycB
    // fully paired and the cycle-closing read inside CycB's literal captures CycA's
    // unpaired base. This use file runs first and reads CycB first precisely so a
    // query-order-driven resolution would break the cycle the other way around.
    local bPeer = debug.getmetatable(CycB).__index;
    local aPeer = debug.getmetatable(CycA).__index;
    local viaA: number = aPeer();
    local viaB: string = bPeer();

==== exclusiveTop.tlua (0 errors) ====
    // A chunk runs once, so the branches of a top-level `if` are mutually
    // exclusive: the else call never meets the then branch's protection.
    declare exclCond: boolean;
    Branches = {};
    if exclCond then
      setmetatable(Branches, {
        __index = { a = 1 },
        __metatable = "locked",
      });
    else
      setmetatable(Branches, { __index = { b = 2 } });
    end

==== exclusiveFn.tlua (1 errors) ====
    // In a function body the same `if` runs per call with the condition free to
    // flip, so the branches are not exclusive and the protection still refuses
    // the else call.
    declare fnCond: boolean;
    FnBranches = {};
    function flipBranches(): void
      if fnCond then
        setmetatable(FnBranches, {
          __index = { a = 1 },
          __metatable = "locked",
        });
      else
        setmetatable(FnBranches, { __index = { b = 2 } });
